name: harness-scaffold-self-evolution-v2
description: Recursive self-improvement of an agent harness at the scaffold layer. With the base model frozen, can a search loop that proposes, evaluates and accepts changes to the agent's scaffold and control flow (chain-of-thought, self-consistency voting, reflexion rounds, plan-then-execute decomposition, verifier-guided retry, and their compositions) discover a scaffold that beats the frozen baseline scaffold on a fixed task suite with an automatic verifier, and does the discovered gain survive on a held-out split? The search itself is the object of study: which proposal strategy and which acceptance rule find real gains rather than overfitting the held-in split.

constraints.frozen_base_model: exactly one open-weights model, at most 8B parameters, fp16 on a single A100-40GB; the model is never trained, fine-tuned or swapped mid-study
constraints.search_space_is_scaffold_only: the search may only vary scaffold and control-flow configuration (prompt structure, number of samples, voting rule, number of reflexion rounds, decomposition depth, retry policy and their compositions); it may never edit source code, install packages or touch any live system
constraints.automatic_verifier_required: every task must be scored by an automatic verifier with no human or LLM judge in the loop: GSM8K exact-match on the final numeric answer, HumanEval unit-test execution. This is what makes the pass rate a real measured number.
constraints.off_the_shelf_benchmarks_only: task suites load directly through HuggingFace datasets with no bespoke agent harness, no simulator, no external service and no network access at scoring time
constraints.frozen_baseline_measured_here: the mandatory baseline is the frozen single-pass scaffold measured on the same model, same task subset and same seeds on this hardware; published numbers are never a baseline
constraints.pre_registered_split: the held-in and held-out task split is fixed and recorded before the first search round; the search only ever sees held-in scores
constraints.acceptance_rule: a proposed scaffold is accepted only when it improves held-in pass rate and does not regress held-out pass rate beyond the pre-registered tolerance
constraints.compute_matched_comparison: scaffolds are compared at matched inference cost (total sampled tokens or total model calls), so a win must not come from simply spending more compute
constraints.numeric_metrics_mandatory: every run persists a real numeric pass rate and a real numeric inference cost; a run whose metric artifacts carry empty values is a failed run, not a completed one
constraints.negative_results_in_scope: finding that no proposed scaffold survives the held-out gate is a valid, reportable outcome and must be reported as such
constraints.model_generation_currency: base model must be a CURRENT-generation open-weights model verified to exist on the configured HuggingFace endpoint on 2026-08-04: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (29.7M downloads), Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B, or Qwen/Qwen3-8B. Qwen2.5, TinyLlama and any pre-Qwen3 generation are explicitly forbidden, including the values hardcoded in agents/experiment_forge.py. If a plan names a model, it must state the date and endpoint on which that model's existence was verified.

out_of_scope: editing the DeepGraph source tree, its configuration, or any live system; the search operates on scaffold configuration only
benchmarks requiring a dedicated agent harness, sandbox or simulator (GAIA, SWE-bench, WebArena, ALFWorld and similar)
training, fine-tuning, RLHF or distillation of the base model
models above 8B parameters or setups needing multi-GPU sharding of one model
unbounded self-modification without a held-out acceptance gate
claims resting on numbers copied from papers rather than measured on this hardware
using a superseded model generation (Qwen2.5-*, TinyLlama-*, google/vit-base-*) or any model whose current existence was not verified against a live registry
